DCTL.description: Design Control Data (DCTL). Fields set the frame sway classification per direction, effective length factor auto-calculation, and the design type dimension.

FRAMEX.description: X-Direction of Frame. Sway classification of the frame along the X direction. Enum values are case-insensitive.

FRAMEY.description: Y-Direction of Frame. Sway classification of the frame along the Y direction. Enum values are case-insensitive.

DT.description: Design Type. Dimensional design type. Enum values are case-insensitive.
